name: Home Assistant
description: Runs Home Assistant in your workspace — control lights, speakers, Alexa/Echo devices and sensors, read the state of your home, and let agents do the same. Opens as a window in the Apps grid, keeps its whole configuration and history on the workspace disk, and comes with the Amazon Alexa integration preinstalled.

volumes.reason: Home Assistant's entire state — configuration.yaml, the .storage auth/registry tree, the recorder SQLite DB, integration deps and automations. Without it every container recreation (app update, workspace redeploy) loses the onboarding, every linked account and all history.

skills.description: Control and query this workspace's Home Assistant — Alexa/Echo devices, media playback, TTS announcements, sensors and device state, over the REST API or the Home Assistant MCP tools.

auto_start.title: Auto-start
auto_start.description: Start Home Assistant automatically when the workspace starts.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone the container runs in, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo. Home Assistant's own time zone is set separately in its onboarding/General settings.
